text: 你看见了一个抱怨天气的农夫。
source_text: 你看见了一个抱怨天气的农夫。

text: What can I do for you?
source_text: What can I do for you?

text: What can you tell me about your village?
source_text: What can you tell me about your village?

text: 你能说说你们村的事情吗？
source_text: 你能说说你们村的事情吗？

text: Our village is small, but we support ourselves. Aside from# the attacks by raiders and the occasional Rad Scorpion,# we have no problems. Aradesh is a good leader.
source_text:
Our village is small, but we support ourselves. Aside from
# the attacks by raiders and the occasional Rad Scorpion,
# we have no problems. Aradesh is a good leader.

text: 我们村不大，但是能够自给自足。除了强盗，或者偶尔来点辐射蝎，我们这里没什么大事。亚拉德什是我们的好领袖。
source_text: 我们村不大，但是能够自给自足。除了强盗，或者偶尔来点辐射蝎，我们这里没什么大事。亚拉德什是我们的好领袖。

text: I am a farmer. We irrigated the desert many years ago.# Although the wasteland is harsh, it is possible to# grow things with patience and time.
source_text:
I am a farmer. We irrigated the desert many years ago.
# Although the wasteland is harsh, it is possible to
# grow things with patience and time.

text: 我是种地的。我们很久前就开始灌溉沙漠了，虽然废土环境恶劣，但只要你有耐心和时间，也是能种地的。
source_text: 我是种地的。我们很久前就开始灌溉沙漠了，虽然废土环境恶劣，但只要你有耐心和时间，也是能种地的。

text: I see. You seem to be doing pretty well.
source_text: I see. You seem to be doing pretty well.

text: 哦，我明白了。你们似乎干的不错。
source_text: 哦，我明白了。你们似乎干的不错。

text: You have all of your fields planted right now? You could# probably do better with crop rotation.
source_text:
You have all of your fields planted right now? You could
# probably do better with crop rotation.

text: 你把所有的地都种满了？也许你应该间作，这样会更好些。
source_text: 你把所有的地都种满了？也许你应该间作，这样会更好些。

text: You only plant some of your fields, allowing the others to get# back some of the nutrients that the plants used up. You let the other fields# become fertile again by just tilling up whatever grows there.
source_text:
You only plant some of your fields, allowing the others to get
# back some of the nutrients that the plants used up. You let the other fields
# become fertile again by just tilling up whatever grows there.

text: 你在一部分土地上耕作，让另一部分空着恢复肥力。你把这些地耙了，以后会更肥沃的。
source_text: 你在一部分土地上耕作，让另一部分空着恢复肥力。你把这些地耙了，以后会更肥沃的。

text: Huh. Never thought of that. Makes sense, though. Good idea.
source_text: Huh. Never thought of that. Makes sense, though. Good idea.

text: 嗯，从没想到。不过很有道理，好主意！
source_text: 嗯，从没想到。不过很有道理，好主意！

text: Can I ask you another question?
source_text: Can I ask you another question?

text: You gain 500 experience points for helping to improve the# agriculture of Shady Sands.
source_text:
You gain 500 experience points for helping to improve the
# agriculture of Shady Sands.

text: 你提高了沙荫镇的农耕水平，获得500点经验值。
source_text: 你提高了沙荫镇的农耕水平，获得500点经验值。
